posts.title: Productivity with only (G)mail & Calendar - No dedicated task tracking apps required
posts.description: Today I want to write about the system I use, in order to not lose track of tasks I have to complete (and actually complete them). I am a strong believer in using one less tool so I only use Gmail and Google calendar - no extra task tracking apps or similar. Remember : What works for me might not work for you. Productivity/task tracking are deeply personal and depend strongly on your working style

posts.title: Triumph Tiger Sport 660 - 2 Year Ownership Review
posts.description: After 2 years of ownership and roughly 7000km, it is time for a review of my motorcycle: the Triumph Tiger Sport 660 .

posts.title: Nürburgring Anlassen 2024 - What an Experience!
posts.description: Yesterday, I went on my biggest motorcycle day trip thus far: From Ratingen to the Nürburgring and back. Visiting the Nürburgring has been my #1 bike-related goal since I got my first motorcycle last year, so the Anlassen/Rev-Up event seemed like the perfect opportunity.
